items.source: This implementation does not provide a typed method for invocation so executions must use one of the generic StoredProcedure.execute(java.util.Map) or StoredProcedure.execute(org.springframework.jdbc.core.ParameterMapper) methods.
items.translation: 此实现未提供用于调用的类型化方法，因此执行必须使用通用的 StoredProcedure.execute(java.util.Map) 或 StoredProcedure.execute(org.springframework.jdbc.core.ParameterMapper) 方法之一。
